_readme: Decisions about DS Health findings. This is the ONE file here you edit by hand —
everything else on the DS Health page is generated from the audit.
Its job is to stop the same finding being re-litigated every week. The Stepper case:
the audit flagged a local `Stepper` as shadowing the DS one, but they were unrelated
components that happened to share a word. Without a record of that call, the next
person to see it asks the same question again.
Key format — type:file:name, never a line number, because lines move:
align    the DS already covers this; the screen should use the real component
promote  a genuine gap; becomes a new DS component or a variant of an existing one
accepted a false positive, or a deliberate exception. It stays as it is.
Every entry needs a `why`. A verdict with no reasoning is how the next person ends up
reversing a decision that was right.
